risks.title: Dependence on global manufacturing supply chain
risks.score_rationale: The presence of a board member specialized in 'global manufacturing, supply chain management' and GMP suggests a critical exposure identified by management. Language around quality and global manufacturing indicates a recurring structural concern.

risks.title: Strict regulatory compliance in the medical devices sector
risks.score_rationale: The explicit mention of GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) expertise at board level, combined with operating in the highly regulated medtech sector, indicates a top-tier regulatory risk. Global regulatory trends (EU MDR, FDA) are tightening.

risks.title: Intense competition from major global medtech players
risks.score_rationale: Board membership with experience in 'major, global healthcare companies' and Cochlear Limited reflects the need to monitor competitive pressure. The single-use endoscopy sector is growing rapidly and attracting established competitors.

risks.title: Technology innovation and product lifecycle risk
risks.score_rationale: The creation of an Innovation Committee within the board and the mention of 'transformative innovation' as a key competency signal the strategic importance—and associated risk—of continuous innovation. The term 'transformative' indicates a high intensity of this risk.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT systems risk in a medical environment
risks.score_rationale: The explicit mention of IT as a key board competency (Henrik Ehlers Wulff, Susanne Larsson) and the increasing digitalization of Ambu's medical devices indicate exposure to cyber risk. Sector trends are rising for connected medical equipment.

risks.title: Dependence on strategic partnerships and health policies
risks.score_rationale: The mention of 'health policy' expertise for Michael Del Prado indicates that Ambu is exposed to public health policy decisions. Hospital procurement policies and reimbursement schemes vary across key geographic markets.

risks.title: Governance and family ownership concentration at Ambu
risks.score_rationale: The explicit statement that Simon Hesse is the 'third generation of the Ambu founding family' on the board indicates family ownership concentration. This may create governance tensions or limit strategic flexibility.

risks.title: Organizational transformation and change management risk
risks.score_rationale: The board's composition reflects expertise in 'transformation and change management' (Susanne Larsson) and 'commercial and operational leadership' (Shacey Petrovic), suggesting Ambu is undergoing significant transformation. Execution risk is high in this context.
